headline: Product search now supports category filters and safe price sorting without changing prices or customer data.
what_changed: Customers can narrow product search results to one category.
Customers can sort product results by name or by price, low to high or high to low.
Unknown sorting choices safely return the normal name-based order.
good_news: The sorting choices are limited to a fixed safe list, so customers cannot alter the database instructions through the sort choice.
The category filter and search text remain separate from the database instructions.
The change is small and limited to product search results.
